title: Regulation of the redox signaling and inflammation by Terminalia myriocarpa leaves and the predictive interactions of it's major metabolites with iNOS and NF-kB.
authors: Siraj, Md Afjalus; Islam Howlader, Md Sariful; Islam, Md Arman; Irin, Tanzira; Simal-Gandara, Jesus
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物抗氧化抗炎作用，仅对代谢物与iNOS/NF-kB蛋白进行简单分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The present study was designed to investigate the regulation of the redox signaling and inflammation by ethanolic leaf extract of Terminalia myriocarpaVan Heurck & Muller (ETM), inspired by the reported antioxidant potential of the plant bark and the anti-edema effect of the same genus. MATERIALS AND METHODS: HPLC-DAD dereplication study was conducted to detect the major polyphenolic secondary metabolites. In-vitro DPPH free radical scavenging assay, nitric oxide (NO) scavenging assay, Fe(2+) ion chelating ability assay and reducing power assay were conducted to evaluate the antioxidant capacity. The molecular mechanism of anti-inflammation was investigated via assessing the NO and NF-kB inhibiting properties in different cell lines. In-vivo carrageenan and histamine-induced edema tests were conducted using established animal models. Pro-inflammatory proteins iNOS and NF-kappaB were docked against the major metabolites of ETM in the in-silico study. RESULTS: HPLC dereplication analysis revealed the presence of considerable amount of ellagic acid, where methyl-(S)-flavogallonate was previously reported in T. myriocarpa. Significant antioxidant activity was found in every in- vitro redox assay conducted. NO was reduced in RAW 264.7 cells, showing 83.67 +/- 4.18% inhibitory activity at the highest tested concentration. TNF-alpha induced NF-kappaB was also observed to be reduced in 293/NF-small ka, CyrillicB-luc cells with an inhibitory activity of 66.23 +/- 0.81% at the highest dose tested. In-vivo carrageenan-induced edema test demonstrated significant anti-inflammatory activity (p < 0.05; p < 0.01) at both doses of 250 and 500 mg/kg with 60.10% highest reduction in rat paw volume. Using same doses, histamine-induced edema test exhibited mentionable anti-inflammatory potential (p < 0.05; p < 0.01) with 67.91% highest reduction in rat paw volume. Moreover, ellagic acid and methyl-(S)-flavogallonate showed significant binding affinity with iNOS (-8.5 and -8.7 Kcal/moL, respectively) and NF-kappaB (-7.3 and -7.3 Kcal/moL, respectively). CONCLUSION: Mentionable basis was found on behalf of the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant potentials of ETM which might be correlated with its NF-kB inhibiting properties.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：本研究旨在探讨千屈菜科植物Terminalia myriocarpa Van Heurck & Muller的乙醇叶片提取物（ETM）对氧化还原信号和炎症的调节作用，其设计灵感来源于该植物树皮已报道的抗氧化潜力及同属植物的抗水肿效应。材料与方法：采用HPLC-DAD去重复化研究检测主要的多酚类次生代谢产物。通过体外DPPH自由基清除实验、一氧化氮（NO）清除实验、Fe(2+)离子螯合能力实验和还原力实验评估抗氧化能力。通过评估不同细胞系中NO和NF-kB的抑制特性，研究抗炎的分子机制。使用已建立的动物模型进行体内角叉菜胶和组胺诱导的水肿实验。在计算机模拟研究中，将促炎蛋白iNOS和NF-kappaB与ETM的主要代谢产物进行分子对接。结果：HPLC去重复化分析显示存在相当数量的鞣花酸，其中甲基-(S)-黄没食子酸酯此前已在T. myriocarpa中报道。所有进行的体外氧化还原实验均显示出显著的抗氧化活性。在RAW 264.7细胞中，NO水平降低，在最高测试浓度下显示出83.67 ± 4.18%的抑制活性。在293/NF-small ka, CyrillicB-luc细胞中，TNF-α诱导的NF-kappaB也观察到降低，在最高测试剂量下抑制活性为66.23 ± 0.81%。体内角叉菜胶诱导的水肿实验在250和500 mg/kg两个剂量下均显示出显著的抗炎活性（p < 0.05；p < 0.01），大鼠爪体积最大减少60.10%。使用相同剂量，组胺诱导的水肿实验显示出值得注意的抗炎潜力（p < 0.05；p < 0.01），大鼠爪体积最大减少67.91%。此外，鞣花酸和甲基-(S)-黄没食子酸酯与iNOS（分别为-8.5和-8.7 Kcal/moL）及NF-kappaB（分别为-7.3和-7.3 Kcal/moL）显示出显著的结合亲和力。结论：为ETM的抗炎和抗氧化潜力找到了值得关注的依据，这可能与其NF-kB抑制特性相关。
